rationale: The suite explicitly designs, tests, and launches prompts and AI models, establishing product-specific AI functionality and a supported positive binary label.
ai_type_rationale: The text centers on tooling for prompts and AI models, but does not establish whether the suite's meaningful core depends on AI or instead conventionally supports building AI systems; ai_native is the best-supported subtype, with that distinction unresolved.
evidence_spans: design, test, and launch high-quality prompts and AI models
ai_type_evidence_spans: design, test, and launch high-quality prompts and AI models
conflict_response: The explicit AI-model and prompt functions settle the positive binary. They do not by themselves show that the tool's own core depends on AI rather than serving as conventional tooling for AI development, so I weaken/force the ai_native subtype rather than infer dependency.
